scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Ignored customer anxiety at [02:50] regarding an imminent business presentation and at [09:40] regarding roof damage when antenna shifted.

grader.scenario: 5G home broadband outdoor antenna misaligned after severe gale force winds
grader.notes: Agent efficiently diagnosed physical 5G antenna misalignment and provided an emergency mobile hotspot pass, but failed to show empathy across two separate customer outbursts regarding business disruption and property damage.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile broadband customer support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Holds were properly announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Damian throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer had two outbursts ([02:50] business presentation threat, [09:40] roof damage fear) and agent offered only procedural responses without acknowledging feelings.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the antenna storm misalignment issue accurately at [01:25].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent maintained accurate context and performed valid checks without improper repeats.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent arranged specialized rigging engineer and provided emergency 50GB tethering pass.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained professional and constructive tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked effective diagnostic questions regarding PoE LED behavior, cable integrity, and antenna orientation.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer tested mobile hotspot tethering, achieved 120 Mbps, and confirmed meeting was saved.
